professionalSummary: Experienced Infrastructure Engineer with a proven track record of upgrading and patching Kubernetes clusters, maintaining Terraform modules and Helm charts, participating in on‑call rotations, and reviewing infrastructure changes. Holds a current Certified Kubernetes Administrator certification.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess fit for Platform Engineer, Kubernetes Infrastructure role.

evidence.text: ran minor-version upgrades on four EKS clusters, draining node groups in batches and keeping a written rollback plan for each upgrade window
Maintained the Terraform modules for VPCs, node groups and IAM roles, and the Helm charts for the ingress controller and the log shipper
Joined the one-week-in-five on-call rotation from January 2024 and wrote runbooks for disk-pressure evictions and failed certificate renewals
Reviewed infrastructure pull requests from the team's two other engineers, reading each Terraform plan before approving the merge

Work sample attached to the CKA requirement: a score report from a timed practice exam on the Kubelab training simulator, dated 2 August 2026, showing 88 out of 100 across 17 tasks and the simulator's verdict 'exam-ready'
